results.gold_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT max_dt AS promo_dt FROM meta_dataset_range WHERE id = 1), promo AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) AS buy_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'pv' THEN user_id END) AS pv_users FROM dwd_behavior_fact WHERE dt = (SELECT promo_dt FROM p)), base AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN user_id END) AS buy_users, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'pv' THEN user_id END) AS pv_users FROM dwd_behavior_fact WHERE dt BETWEEN (SELECT DATE_SUB(promo_dt, INTERVAL 7 DAY) FROM p) AND (SELECT DATE_SUB(promo_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM p)) SELECT ROUND(promo.buy_users / NULLIF(promo.pv_users, 0), 4) AS promo_rate, ROUND(base.buy_users / NULLIF(base.pv_users, 0), 4) AS base_rate, ROUND((promo.buy_users / NULLIF(promo.pv_users, 0) - base.buy_users / NULLIF(base.pv_users, 0)) / NULLIF(base.buy_users / NULLIF(base.pv_users, 0), 0), 4) AS lift FROM promo, base
